title: Why and When Neural Networks Improve Local Approximation in Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.24963v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Published experience with neural surrogates in derivative-free optimisation is contradictory: the same family of models that cuts the evaluation count of one solver leaves another unchanged, or makes it worse. We show that the contradiction dissolves once three factors are stated, and that these, rather than the fit accuracy a training curve reports, are what delimit when a learned local model pays. Role: a surrogate that proposes candidates the true objective must still approve helps, while one that replaces a gradient the solver depends on hurts. Radius: a model fitted to an optimisation path is reliable only inside a bounded neighbourhood, and its error neither vanishes as that neighbourhood shrinks nor survives its growth. Room: a surrogate can only accelerate progress the base method is still able to make. translated_title: 为什么以及何时神经网络能改进优化中的局部近似
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24963v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：关于神经代理模型在无导数优化中的已有经验是矛盾的：同一类模型能减少一个求解器的评估次数，却对另一个求解器没有影响，甚至使其变差。我们表明，一旦明确了三个因素，这一矛盾便得以化解，而这些因素——而非训练曲线所报告的拟合精度——才是决定学习型局部模型何时值得使用的关键。角色：一个提出候选解但最终仍需真实目标函数批准的代理模型是有帮助的，而一个替代求解器所依赖的梯度的代理模型则是有害的。半径：拟合到优化路径上的模型仅在有限邻域内可靠，其误差既不会随邻域缩小而消失，也不会在邻域扩大时保持不变。空间：代理模型只能加速基础方法仍能取得的进展。我们形式化了半径感知的局部泛化，将其与经典的完全线性条件联系起来，并用每个因素进行了测试。
tldr: 神经网络在优化中改进局部近似的效果取决于三个关键因素——角色、半径和空间，而非单纯拟合精度，这解释了以往矛盾的经验结果。
en_tdlr: Neural networks improve local approximation in optimization only when three factors—role, radius, and room—are satisfied, rather than based on fit accuracy alone, resolving previously contradictory empirical results.
